description: The pie chart illustrates the Token Routing Distribution for FedHLM, representing the proportion of different categories. The chart is divided into three slices. The largest slice, labeled "LOCAL" and colored green, occupies approximately 94.5% of the chart. The second slice, labeled "LLM" and colored red, accounts for around 3.9%. The smallest slice, labeled "EDGE_P2P" and colored blue, represents about 1.6%. The percentage values are displayed inside each slice. The slices are arranged in descending order of their proportions, with the largest slice being "LOCAL" and the smallest being "EDGE_P2P". No legend is present in the chart, and none of the slices are visually emphasized.
